acceptanceCriteria: An owner-accepted spec (or an amendment to affected-plan-v0) records the in-scope set among Objective-C, C/C++/JNI and shell, with explicit exclusions for any language left out and for non-test-bearing analyzer families (SQL-native, shader, HTML/CSS, structured-data).

Each accepted language has an affected.Language adapter registered in internal/liveverify/affected/languages.All(), with discovery of its main test framework (for example XCTest for Objective-C .m/.mm, CTest/GoogleTest for C/C++, bats for shell) and graph edges from changed sources to tests.
Unresolved or unsupported cases abstain as UNKNOWN rather than selecting nothing; per-language groundtruth and conformance tests pass alongside the existing eight adapter suites.
corvint affected on a fixture repository in each accepted language reports selected tests with witnesses instead of only unknown paths; focused tests and one independent review are retained.
body: Observed 2026-10-12 on main 3beedd981 (corvint-tasks build456, go1.27.2 host). Gap audit: Corvint ships 16 analyzer families (cmd/corvint-analyzer-*), but `corvint affected` registers only eight test-selection adapters in internal/liveverify/affected/languages/languages.go: dotnet, golang, kotlin (also .java/Gradle), python, ruby, rust, swift, typescript. The swift adapter only matches .swift, so Objective-C (.m/.mm, XCTest), C/C++/JNI (cmd/corvint-analyzer-c-jni) and shell (cmd/corvint-analyzer-shell) changes have no test selection and fall to UNKNOWN. SQL-native, shader, HTML/CSS and structured-data are not test-bearing and need only explicit exclusion. Expected: every supported test-bearing language either has an affected adapter or an explicit recorded exclusion. Actual: three test-bearing analyzer languages have neither. Distinct from runner execution coverage (V1-0591, V1-0593 C/C++ runners, V1-0594 Apple runners), which covers running tests, not diff-to-test selection; coordinate with those children. All eight existing adapter suites pass: go test ./internal/liveverify/affected/{dotnet,golang,kotlin,python,ruby,rust,swift,typescript}.
title: affected: add test-selection adapters (or recorded exclusions) for Objective-C, C/C++/JNI and shell
